classification.difficultyReason: Combines ten annual decreases and twenty annual increases, then interprets the combined multiplier as an overall percentage change.

content.prompt: The number of trees on Green Plateau fell by $5\%$ every year for 10 years. Then the numbers rose by $5\%$ every year for 20 years. What was the total percentage gain or loss of trees over the 30-year period? Give your answer correct to 2 decimal places.

answer.short:
Gain of $58.86\%$.

Multiply the annual change factors: $0.95^{10}\times1.05^{20}$.
answer.worked:
The annual multipliers are $1-0.05=0.95$ for decreases and $1+0.05=1.05$ for increases.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Combined multiplier}&=0.95^{10}\times1.05^{20}\\\text{Combined multiplier}&\approx1.5886273469\\\text{Percentage gain}&=(0.95^{10}\times1.05^{20}-1)\times100\%\\\text{Percentage gain}&\approx58.86\%\end{align*}$$

There was a total gain of $58.86\%$ over the 30 years.
